template_data.headline_html: Five things most owners miss about small business certs.

items.title: Access, not revenue
items.sub: Set-asides open the lane — you still have to bid, price, and follow through.

items.title: Certifications stack
items.sub: SDVOSB + WOSB + GSA Schedule is a real combination that opens multiple lanes.

items.title: All require maintenance
items.sub: 8(a) reviews, SDVOSB renewals, HUBZone recerts — miss one mid-opportunity and you're out.

items.title: Sub before you prime
items.sub: Primes need certified subs for set-asides. Being that sub builds past performance fast.

items.title: SAM.gov must match
items.sub: Misaligned NAICS codes or ownership data fail pre-award verification before COs call.
